title: Otori Emu — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day before Emu's birthday
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-W-Wow! Thanks, you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys really surprised me when you asked me to come over to SEKAI all of a sudden, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But now I see it was for my birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Our surprise went off without a hitch♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We heard that you'd be busy on your actual birthday, so we decided to throw you a party a little early.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?! That makes me so happy♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others are throwing you a party tomorrow, right?! What are you guys gonna do?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're having a tea party tomorrow☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A tea party?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna meet up after school and have some delicious tea while munching on yummy snacks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's what they came up with after I said I wanted a party that would be fun for everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?!
That sounds super duper fun☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I'm so excited that I don't know if I'm gonna be able to sleep.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
All you have to do is close your eyes and... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, Luka!
We're not about to let you fall asleep in the middle of the party!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We gotta get her to wake up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope you get to have a wonderful birthday tomorrow, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
And thanks for throwing me this party, you guys☆
The next day
Rental Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Everyone!
You guys are so wonderhoy for waiting☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, huh? There's no one here...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Uh oh...
Did I come to the wrong place?!

No, you did not!
This is the right place, Emu!
Or rather, Princess Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Princess...?
se_walk_men_005_4

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's right.
You are our princess... The princess of Emuland.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And we are your faithful servants.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, Princess, please take a seat in this chair.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wah...!
Um, thanks, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like a real princess now for some reason♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Not “like” a princess. You are a princess.
And here's the proof. Take a look...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You forgot to put this on, Princess.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
It's so sparkly, dazzling and cute...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is this a tiara?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, and it suits you very well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then, since our princess has arrived, let us begin our tea party.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Starting with the dried fruit tea. Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This tea has strawberries in it!
Hehe. And it smells so good...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In order to strike a balance with the dried fruit, we decided to blend it with some not-so-bitter Japanese black tea.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?!
And this cup's adorable. I'm so excited to try this♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We're glad that you like what you see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Next, we'll serve the tea snacks.
Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, just a moment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here you are, Princess.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This cake... It's shaped like a fish...?!
And it's so big!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Not just any fish.
Please try taking a closer look.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, is this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A taiyaki cake?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that is correct.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And there are even more taiyaki inside. We wanted you to enjoy a variety of different flavors, Princess.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's amazing!
Did you guys bake this...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, all we did was come up with the idea.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We made a request to your family chef through your brothers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They asked to have this made...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
Thanks, I feel so happy...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. This tea and cake and show all feel so festive and celebratory...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This has become a really special and won-won-wonderhoy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, but the party is not about to end just yet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? But that's it for the tea and snacks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is your birthday, after all, Princess.
We are far from finished celebrating.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You see, Princess, some others have expressed that they also wish to celebrate your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You could call them special guests.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Special guests...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now then, let us begin—
From this point on, you are going to have a very special time!
